# OVT MCP resources

The full registry is active as of M2. No resource exposes raw text, profile values, keys, secrets, or paths — every dynamic resource returns only counts, enums, booleans, and timestamps.

| uri | kind | tier | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ovt://guidance/getting-started` | static | m1 | How to run setup, add a source, ingest, and request a voice-matched draft. |
| `ovt://guidance/safety` | static | m1 | LOCAL_ONLY default, consequence challenges, off/erase, and what OVT never does automatically. |
| `ovt://guidance/continual-learning` | static | m1 | Direct feedback beats inference; sources are opt-in; third-party text is never operator evidence. |
| `ovt://guidance/feedback` | static | m1 | How to say 'that's wrong' / 'I'd say it differently' in plain language and what happens next. |
| `ovt://guidance/context-bundle` | static | m2 | Fields, token budgeting, and abstention behavior of the bundle returned by `context.get`. |
| `ovt://guidance/external-subjects` | static | m2 | Why external-person analysis requires explicit enrollment and never produces authoring instructions. |
| `ovt://guidance/template-integration` | static | m2 | How a consuming template contract consumes a bundle without importing OVT internals. |
| `ovt://status/profile` | dynamic | m1 | Redacted subject/fact counts and generation state. |
| `ovt://status/sources` | dynamic | m1 | Redacted per-source adapter type, active/paused state, and last-ingest time. |
| `ovt://status/sync` | dynamic | m1 | LOCAL_ONLY vs ENCRYPTED_GIT, and (if configured) local/remote generation parity. |
| `ovt://status/environment` | dynamic | m1 | Redacted capability flags, schema version, and gateway posture (never a raw path or key). |
| `ovt://status/learning` | dynamic | m2 | Calibration/drift summary across contexts plus correction-uptake (M3: how many operator corrections were recorded and taken up). |
| `ovt://status/curation` | dynamic | m3 | Recent passive-curation tick history (status/counts/catch-up gap/recovered runs) and per-source watermarks. Content-free — counts, enums, and timestamps only. |
| `ovt://status/dashboard` | dynamic | m4 | Redacted, content-free status snapshot backing the render-only Cursor dashboard: runtime posture, subject/fact/review counts, sync + EXTERNAL-egress state. Never a fact value, raw text, or an EXTERNAL subject's name. |
